cards.audioText: [Your call sign is AFR126, destination Beijing, 8900m maintaining, over TMR, TZH 10, squawk 6021, now contact Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是法航126，目的地北京，高度8900米，应答机6021，飞过TMR, 到达TZH时间10分，现在联系北京区调。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, AFR126, 8900m maintaining, over TMR, TZH 10, squawk 6021.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，法航126，高度8900米保持，过TMR，预计TZH时间10分，应答机6021。

cards.audioText: AFR126, Beijing Control, squawk 6021, standard, negative short cut, over fly TZH due to Air Force activity.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，北京区调，应答机6021，按标准程序飞，不能直飞，由于空军活动，过TZH。
cards.referenceText: Over fly TZH due to Air Force movement, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于空军活动，过TZH，法航126。

cards.audioText: [Ask the controller which runway is in use.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【询问管制员哪条跑道可用。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, AFR126, request runway in use.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，法航126，申请可用跑道。

cards.audioText: AFR126, expect KM01 arrival, runway in use 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，预计KM01进场，跑道36左可用。
cards.referenceText: Expect KM01 arrival, runway 36L, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计KM01进场，跑道36左，法航126。

cards.audioText: [Ask whether you can use KM03 arrival and land on runway 01.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【询问是否可以KM03进场，降落在跑道01上。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, AFR126, if available, request KM03 arrival, landing on runway 01.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，法航126，如果可以，请求KM03进场，着陆跑道01.

cards.audioText: AFR126, after KM, you can request Beijing Approach for change of runway.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，过KM后，可以向北京进近请求更换跑道。
cards.referenceText: Roger. After KM, request change runway, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，KM后，请求更换跑道，法航126。

cards.audioText: AFR126, descend to and maintain 4500m over KM.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，过KM下降保持4500米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 4500m over KM, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持4500米，过KM，法航126。

cards.audioText: AFR126, contact Beijing Approach 119.7, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，联系北京进近119.7，再见。
cards.referenceText: 119.7, good day, AFR126.

cards.audioText: [Over KM, maintaining 4500m, contact Beijing Approach and request runway 01, KM03 arrival.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在KM上方，保持4500米，联系北京进近，请求跑道01，KM03进场。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR126, over KM, maintaining 4500m, request runway 01, KM03 arrival.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，法航126，过KM，保持4500米，请求跑道01，KM03进场。

cards.audioText: AFR126, negative due to spacing, KM01 arrival, runway in use 36L, information A.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，由于间隔不同意跑道01，KM01进场，使用跑道36左，通播A。
cards.referenceText: KM01 arrival, runway in use 36L, information A, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: KM01进场，使用跑道36左，通播A，法航126.

cards.audioText: [Tell the controller that your flap has some problems.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告知管制员襟翼有问题】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR126, our flap has some problems.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，法航126，我们的襟翼有问题。

cards.audioText: AFR126, roger, say intention. [You have to hold for a check.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，收到，请示意图。【你必须盘旋检查。】
cards.referenceText: Request holding for a check, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求等待盘旋检查，法航126。

cards.audioText: AFR126, descend to and maintain 3000m on QNH 1012, turn left direct to HUR, hold as published.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，下降保持修正海压3000米，修正海压1012，左转直飞HUR，标准等待。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 3000m on QNH 1012, turn left direct to HUR, hold as published, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持修正海压3000米，修正海压1012，左转直飞HUR，标准等待，法航126。

cards.audioText: [Operations are now normal, request landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【操作正常，请求降落。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR126, operations are now normal, request landing/to cancel hold.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，法航126，操作正常，请求着陆（取消等待）。

cards.audioText: AFR126, Beijing Approach, continue holding. Runway is being cleaned due thick snow, landing action poor.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，北京进近，继续等待。跑道有积雪，正在清理，着陆效应差。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue holding, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，法航126

cards.audioText: AFR126, snow is getting heavier, you have to hold about 1 hour.[The remaining fuel can hold for half hour; you have to request diversion.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，雪越来越大，你必须等大约1小时。【剩余燃油只能维持半小时，你不得不请求改航。】
cards.referenceText: Our endurance is 0030, request diversion, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 续航时间30分钟，请求改航，法航126。

cards.audioText: AFR126, stand by.[Your fuel temperature indicates abnormal, you can only hold 10 minutes, request divert to Dalian airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，稍等。【燃油温度显示异常，能继续等待10分钟，请求改航至大连机场。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR126, fuel temperature warning light on, endurance only 10 minutes, request divert to Dalian.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，法航126，油温警告灯亮了，续航能力仅10分钟，请求改航至大连。

cards.audioText: Standby one, we will ask Air Force to use a temporary route.
cards.audioTextZh: 稍等，向空军申请临时航路。
cards.referenceText: Roger, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，法航126。

cards.audioText: AFR126, climb to and maintain 8100m on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，上升保持标压8100米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 8100m on standard, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持标压8100米，法航126。

cards.audioText: AFR126, direct to Dalian airport, contact Beijing Control 120.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，直飞大连机场，联系北京区调120.35。
cards.referenceText: Direct to Dalian, 120.35, AFR126.
